metadata.case_name: LAU TIM SHUN v. CITY ENGINEERING LTD AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to his back
source: The joint experts opined that the plaintiff sustained soft tissue injury to his back during work.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

injuries.description: Degenerative and developmental changes in the lower thoracic and lumbar spine including slight posterior disc bulging at multiple levels, disc degeneration and dehydration at T11/T12, slight spondylosis and multiple small chronic Schmorl's nodes
source: (i) Slight posterior bulging of the T10/11, T11/12, T12/L1, L1/2, L2/3, L3/4 and L4/5 discs, causing slight indentation on the anterior part of the thecal sac.
(ii) Disc Degeneration and dehydration at T11/T12 level.
(iii) No central canal, lateral recesses or neural foramina stenosis in the lumbar spine.
(v) Slight spondylosis in the lumbar spine.
(vi) Multiple small chronic Schmorl’s nodes in the lower thoracic and lumbar vertebral bodies.
